Queer Fantasy Story Generator

Settings

Worlds, casts and plots for queer fantasy: court intrigue, quests, war, heists and cozy romance.

What is a world seed?

A seed is the starting text everything is built from. The same seed always produces the same world: the same coastlines, rivers, climate, cities, borders, cultures and names. Type any word or phrase (for example ashes of jade) and press Load to see its world. Share the seed, or the page link, and anyone who opens it gets the identical world.

Two numbers sit on top of the world seed. Characters sets the cast: Reroll characters keeps the map and peoples but brings a new protagonist backstory and a new cast. Plot sets the story: Reroll plot keeps the cast and changes the premise, deadline, themes, hooks and acts. Together they make a seed code like ashen-crane-412 · characters 2 · plot 5.

Story type, protagonist and romance settings are in .

AI add-on

Everything in this app works without AI: chat answers from your writing and takes commands, Read my story fills in the Story Bible, and Feedback, Rewrite, Describe, Brainstorm and openings run on built-in engines. Switch the add-on on when you want AI to draft and rewrite in your voice.

Each service keeps its own key in this browser, so switching back fills it in.

Your key is saved only in this browser on this device. It isn't stored in the page itself, so sharing the file doesn't share your key.

Your map picture

Right-click or long-press the image to save it. If it didn't download by itself, that's the way to keep it.
